name: Centre for Trade Policy and Development (CTPD) and the Zambia Tax Platform (report for ActionAid Zambia, June 2022)
detail: "An Analysis of the Zambian Taxation System" has a section on how a progressive net wealth tax could be designed, but recommendation viii asks for better enforcement of property, capital gains and dividend taxes and says re-examining those taxes "may be preferable" to imposing a net wealth tax. ActionAid Zambia is recorded on its own 2020 statement instead.

name: Afrobarometer dispatch AD883 (October 2024)
detail: 73% of Zambians said it is fair for the rich to be taxed at higher rates: a question on progressive rates, not on a wealth tax, so it is not entered as a poll.

name: Escalating land holdings tax (M'membe, September 2026)
detail: A tax on landholdings above 200 hectares is a land tax; only the separate wealth tax in the same programme counts.
